Set up your BIOS in DuckStation. Supports CHD, unencrypted PBP, PS-EXE, CUE with BIN/WAVE tracks and flat M3U disc lists. Keep every referenced file inside the selected folder, using relative paths and exact letter case.

Add ROM files or installed Azahar games. CIA packages must be installed in Azahar first; choose “Installed Azahar games” to add them to this library.
Select the user data folder chosen during Azahar setup. It contains the sdmc, nand and config folders. GOSTEX will find installed games there; saves and system content are excluded.

In Azahar, open Options → Install CIA file and choose your CIA. Then return here, select “Installed Azahar games” and choose the Azahar user data folder. Games installed later will appear when the library refreshes.
